title: Midlife Survivors: Promoted Four Times Before Lunch
use: Devlog post 08 cover and share image

style.medium: 16-bit pixel art, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliased blur
style.match: the existing Midlife Survivors office key art and title screen
style.outline: 1px navy outline on characters and props
style.lighting: warm light from upper left, soft stepped shadows to the lower right
style.tone: warm, funny, a little exhausted, never mean

scene.concept: A corporate promotion as a heroic moment. The hero stands in a hallway as a big garage-style office door rolls up behind him, revealing a glowing new wing of the office. Above the door, a cheap banner reads PROMOTED.

hero.name: The 9-to-5er
hero.build: average build, slightly rounded posture, early 40s
hero.hair: messy brown hair with a little grey at the temples
hero.face: rectangular black glasses, tired but proud half-smile
hero.clothes: white short-sleeve dress shirt, loose red tie, khaki slacks, brown shoes
hero.prop: raising an orange coffee mug like a trophy, with a little steam curl
hero.pose: three-quarter view, walking toward the camera, chin up

midground.door: a roll-up office door halfway open, with AGE 50 on a small sign beside it
midground.through_the_door: a preview of the new rooms in layers: blinking blue server racks with a cable waterfall, a glass conference room with a long table and a half-erased roadmap whiteboard, and far back, the warm wood of an executive corner office

background_and_edges.left_edge: the Bullpen behind him: CRT monitors on cubicle desks, paper drifts, a coworker peeking over a partition and giving a tired thumbs-up
background_and_edges.right_edge: a small crowd of the enemies chasing him, cute and silly: a paper Bill with a red band, a purple Spam Likely phone, a pink-frosted donut, a calendar invite
background_and_edges.far_right_hint: a cherry-red sports car's headlight glowing in the dark, the Midlife Crisis V8 waiting

details: a little confetti falling from the PROMOTED banner
a single party horn on the floor
a sticky note on the door frame that says 'congrats?? -HR'

text_in_image: Only the words PROMOTED, AGE 50 and the sticky note. No logo, no title text (the devlog adds its own).
